newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar closes on its lows after tight trade.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar closes on its lows after tight trade.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed on its lows on Monday but the trading range for the session was reasonably tight.
It ended at 5.00 p.m. (0400 GMT) at US$0.6912/22 after trading a 0.6915-40 range.
Dealers said there was selling out of Tokyo when the Kiwi approached 0.6925 and one dealer said some of the selling came from names which more typically had been buyers of late.
"It feels a bit soggy. I think it is unlikely to rally above 0.6925-30," he said.
The Trade-Weighted Index closed at 68.92 after opening at 68.99 and approaching fresh 8-1/2 year highs during the session.
Traders are expecting further range trading at least until the Labour Cost survey due on Friday.
